jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: The "Manager" title and £52,088 Project/Regional Leads/Managers pay band place this well above entry-level, and a strategic litigation lead role would require senior legal and management experience the candidate lacks. Reprieve's human-rights and justice mission is a perfect interest match, but the level is a hard mismatch.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employer pension contribution

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is a genuine entry-level (Coordinator band) role at a core-mission human-rights organisation, so it is eligible and winnable, but it is a fundraising function that draws on marketing/donor-development skills the candidate does not have and away from research and analysis. The Reprieve context is compelling, but the fundraising specialism sits outside the candidate's strengths and interests, holding the priority down.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% employer pension contribution

jobs.title: Script Editor (EastEnders)
jobs.reason: The role's essential criteria require proven prior experience as a TV drama Script Editor and in-depth knowledge of EastEnders — professional media-production experience the candidate does not have. It is also based in Borehamwood, outside London with no London-office or fully-remote-UK option, failing the London-only filter. The subject is wholly outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a Director role with ultimate executive responsibility, leading a senior team of three Deputy Directors — far beyond entry-level and requiring extensive senior leadership experience the candidate does not have. The £80k–£95k salary and executive scope confirm the seniority mismatch, so it is ineligible despite the relevant subject area.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role — it seeks established practitioners/activists and reads as a voluntary advisory appointment rather than a salaried vacancy the candidate could take. The human-rights and securitisation subject is on-mission, but the level and nature of the post are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellowship x2 (SARChI Chair) (AC.09.4)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD in public health, health economics, or biostatistics (obtained within the past five years), which the candidate does not hold — a hard disqualifier for a postdoctoral role. The health-workforce / public-health focus is also well outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - Food
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: a "Senior" title requiring a minimum of 5 years' food-industry experience, plus essential food-technology qualifications and 3rd-party auditing certifications (FSSC 22000, BRCGS, HACCP) the candidate does not hold. The role is entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.

jobs.title: International Member Youth Representative (4254)
jobs.reason: This is an unpaid volunteer governance role, which is excluded by policy regardless of fit. It also requires being 22 or younger and having been an active international member for over a year — criteria the candidate does not meet. Despite the human-rights context, it is not a genuine paid role for the candidate.
jobs.location: Not specified (remote / global; not IS office-based)
jobs.salary: Not specified (unpaid volunteer role; travel expenses covered)

jobs.title: Associate or Senior Editor, Nature Reviews Computing
jobs.reason: The role names a PhD in a topic relevant to the journal as the ideal-candidate requirement, and the field is computer science / AI / theoretical computing — an already-completed doctorate in a technical field the candidate does not hold, which is a hard disqualifier. It is also far outside the candidate's international-law and policy background.
